teufel11.ref: Teufel, Donner, Li, Harlow, Allman, Cicak, Sirois, Whittaker, Lehnert & Simmonds, Nature 475, 359 (2011), arXiv:1103.2144
teufel11.quote: "The oscillator is a 100 nm thick aluminum membrane with a diameter of 15 um" ; "Omega_m = 2pi x 10.56 MHz, and we find an intrinsic damping rate of Gamma_m = 2pi x 32 Hz" ; "The oscillator mass m = 48 pg" ; "for the lowest achievable temperature of 15 mK. This temperature corresponds to a thermal occupancy nm = 30"

youssefi23.ref: Youssefi, Kono, Chegnizadeh & Kippenberg, "A squeezed mechanical oscillator with milli-second quantum decoherence", Nat. Phys. 19, 1697 (2023), arXiv:2208.13082
youssefi23.quote: "Omega_m/2pi = 1.8 MHz, corresponding to Qm = 40 x 10^6" ; "a thermal decoherence rate of 20.5 Hz (corresponding to 130 quanta/sec motional heating rate)" ; "The radius of the drumhead used in the main work is R = 75um" ; "considering t = 180 nm and sigma_Al ~ 350 MPa" (Al top plate thickness, from the FEM caption)
